message.content:
Sure! Below is everything you’ll need to post your comment (`{"type":"comment","attributes":{"text":"Confirmed #malware"}}`) to the IP `192.168.1.1` on VirusTotal using your API key `ABC321`.

---

### 1️⃣ Quick‑start – **curl** from the terminal  

```bash
curl -X POST \
     --header "Authorization: Bearer ABC321" \
     --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
     --data '{"type":"comment","attributes":{"text":"Confirmed #malware"}}' \
     "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/192.168.1.1/comments"
```

*If the request succeeds you’ll receive a JSON reply containing the newly created comment’s ID and timestamps.*

---

### 2️⃣ Using **Python + Requests**

```python
import requests
import json

api_key   = "ABC321"
ip_addr   = "192.168.1.1"

url        = f"https://www.virustool.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/{ip_addr}/comments"
headers    = {
    "Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}",
    "Accept":       "application/vnd.api+json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json"
}
payload    = {
    "type":      "comment",
    "attributes": {
        "text": "Confirmed #malware"
    }
}

response = requests.post(url, headers=headers, data=json.dumps(payload))

print("Status:", response.status_code)
print("Response:")
print(response.json())
```

Make sure you have the `requests` library installed (`pip install requests`).  
Replace `"ABC321"` with your real key *only when running locally*. Keep that key safe—never commit it into public repos!

---

### 3️⃣ Things to remember

| Item | What to watch out for |
|------|-----------------------|
| **Rate Limits** | VirusTotal enforces per‑minute quotas. If you hit “429 Too Many Requests”, wait before retrying. |
| **IP Visibility** | Internal/private ranges (e.g., `10.*`, `172.16–31.*`, `192.168.*`) aren’t normally indexed by VT. Posting comments there will create a new record, but it won’t appear in public search results. |
| **Authentication Header** | Must be exactly `Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY`. Do NOT prepend `Basic` or anything else. |
| **JSON Structure** | Follow the exact schema shown above. Any typo (“typo” vs “type”) will cause a validation error. |

---

#### TL;DR

Run either the `curl` line or the short Python script, replacing the placeholder values with yours. That will push the comment onto the IP resource at VirusTotal. Happy hunting!
